summary: Completed frontend testing of QR scan and penalty (cərimə) system. QR scan page works correctly, admin panel behavior management has penalty functionality implemented with separate amount and points fields, worker dashboard has penalty section.

authentication_issues.issue: Admin session management unstable - frequent redirects to login page
authentication_issues.impact: Prevents consistent testing of penalty functionality

passed_tests: QR Scan page loads correctly with session parameter (/workers/qr-scan?session=test)
QR Scan page displays proper login form with email, password, and submit button
Session parameter correctly displayed on QR scan page
Admin login page loads and accepts credentials
Behavior Management page exists and shows behavior records
Code review confirms CƏRIMƏ type is implemented in BehaviorManagement component
Code review confirms separate amount (məbləğ) and points (bal) input fields for penalties
Code review confirms Worker Dashboard has penalty/warning section with amount display
Code review confirms penalty amounts are displayed in admin penalty list
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix admin session management issue - admin panel keeps redirecting to login page, preventing full testing of penalty functionality. The penalty system code is properly implemented but cannot be fully tested due to authentication issues.
